newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet steady despite crude jump, market balanced.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet steady despite crude jump, market balanced.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were unchanged, despite a jump in crude and gas oil, dealers said on Thursday.
Large volumes of barges were sold at Dec +$32 fob ARA, $2 below the previous level, and cargoes were valued around parity with barges.
One dealer saw a cargo from the Caribbean arriving in Europe in the second half of November, but also reported steady demand from airlines in that period.
